events.title: Ronin bridge exploit

research.summary: Attackers compromised validator keys on Axie Infinity's Ronin bridge and withdrew 173,600 ETH and 25.5 million USDC; the theft was discovered days later.
research.significance: Ronin became one of the largest crypto thefts ever and showed the danger of concentrated validator control in bridge security.

sources.title: TechCrunch — Ronin bridge theft

events.title: UST loses its peg

research.summary: TerraUSD (UST) began trading materially below its intended $1 peg on 8 May 2022 and failed to restore sustained parity as withdrawals from Anchor accelerated.
research.significance: The depeg broke the core economic assumption behind Terra's algorithmic stablecoin system and triggered one of crypto's largest systemic collapses.

sources.title: Terra Research Forum — UST peg-loss recovery proposal
Terra Research Forum — Ecosystem Revival Plan

events.title: LUNA death spiral

research.summary: As UST holders exited through Terra's mint-and-burn mechanism, LUNA supply expanded explosively while LUNA's price collapsed toward zero.
research.significance: The feedback loop became the archetypal algorithmic-stablecoin death spiral and destroyed Terra's original economic model.

sources.title: Terra Research Forum — UST peg-loss recovery proposal
Terra Research Forum — Ecosystem Revival Plan

events.title: Three Arrows Capital collapses

research.summary: Voyager declared Three Arrows Capital in default on loans of 15,250 BTC and $350 million USDC on 27 June; a British Virgin Islands court then ordered 3AC into liquidation.
research.significance: The failure of one of crypto's largest hedge funds exposed interconnected leverage and became a central transmission mechanism in the 2022 credit crisis.

sources.title: Voyager Digital — Market Update / 3AC default
Washington Post — Three Arrows Capital ordered into liquidation

events.title: Tornado Cash sanctions

research.summary: The US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned Tornado Cash, identifying its smart-contract-based mixing service and related addresses under US sanctions authorities.
research.significance: The action triggered a major global debate about sanctions, privacy technology, immutable smart contracts and whether code can be treated like a conventional entity.

sources.title: US Treasury — sanctions Tornado Cash
US Treasury — Tornado Cash designation

events.title: Ethereum Merge

research.summary: Ethereum completed The Merge on 15 September 2022, replacing proof-of-work block production with proof-of-stake consensus coordinated through the Beacon Chain.
research.significance: The Merge was one of the largest live consensus migrations in blockchain history and fundamentally changed Ethereum's issuance, validator economics and energy footprint.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — The Merge

events.title: FTX collapses and files for bankruptcy

research.summary: FTX Trading and a large group of affiliated companies filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in Delaware, and John J. Ray III replaced Sam Bankman-Fried as chief executive.
research.significance: FTX's collapse destroyed one of the industry's largest exchanges, triggered widespread contagion and became the defining crypto corporate failure of 2022.

sources.title: FTX bankruptcy announcement coverage
John J. Ray III First Day Declaration, FTX Ch.11

events.title: Wormhole bridge exploit

research.summary: The Wormhole bridge was exploited for 120,000 wrapped ETH, worth roughly $320 million at the time, after an attacker bypassed verification and minted unbacked assets.
research.significance: The exploit became one of the first mega-scale bridge failures and highlighted cross-chain verification as a systemic security risk.

sources.title: TechCrunch — Wormhole exploit

events.title: Celsius freezes withdrawals

research.summary: Celsius paused all withdrawals, swaps and transfers between customer accounts, citing extreme market conditions.
research.significance: The freeze turned abstract CeFi balance-sheet concerns into a bank-run-style crisis for retail depositors.

sources.title: Vermont DFR — Celsius files Chapter 11
Celsius bankruptcy case portal

events.title: Voyager Digital enters bankruptcy

research.summary: Voyager Digital and affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after severe market stress and 3AC's default.
research.significance: Voyager's bankruptcy demonstrated how 3AC losses propagated through retail-facing crypto lenders.

sources.title: Voyager Digital Chapter 11 announcement
Voyager Digital — Market Update / 3AC default

events.title: Nomad bridge exploit becomes a copycat free-for-all

research.summary: A configuration error in Nomad's bridge allowed attackers to replay a successful withdrawal message; more than 300 addresses copied transactions and over $186 million was removed.
research.significance: Nomad became crypto's most literal 'copy-paste' hack, with opportunistic addresses joining the exploit after the flaw became obvious.

sources.title: Nomad — Nomad Bridge Hack: Root Cause Analysis

events.title: BlockFi enters bankruptcy following FTX contagion

research.summary: BlockFi and several affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection following the FTX collapse and associated market stress.
research.significance: BlockFi's failure became a direct second-order casualty of FTX and completed another link in the 2022 CeFi contagion chain.

sources.title: BlockFi restructuring case portal

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is arrested

research.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas following charges filed by US federal prosecutors.
research.significance: The arrest moved the FTX story from corporate collapse into criminal prosecution.

sources.title: DOJ — Sam Bankman-Fried charged following Bahamas arrest

events.title: EU reaches political agreement on MiCA

research.summary: EU negotiators reached a provisional political agreement on the Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation (MiCA).
research.significance: MiCA established the basis for the EU's comprehensive cross-border crypto-asset regulatory framework.

sources.title: Council of EU — provisional MiCA agreement

events.title: Central African Republic adopts Bitcoin as legal tender

research.summary: The Central African Republic enacted a law giving cryptocurrencies, and Bitcoin in particular, legal-tender status alongside the CFA franc.
research.significance: CAR became the second country after El Salvador to make Bitcoin legal tender and the first to do so while belonging to a monetary union.

sources.title: IMF — CEMAC staff report on CAR Bitcoin legal-tender law

events.title: Crypto advertising dominates the Super Bowl

research.summary: Super Bowl LVI featured a cluster of cryptocurrency advertisements; Coinbase itself described the game as being dubbed the 'Crypto Bowl' because of the number of crypto companies advertising.
research.significance: The advertising saturation became a vivid symbol of crypto's 2021-22 mainstream marketing peak just months before the industry downturn.

sources.title: Coinbase — Everyone Wins at Super Bowl LVI — WAGMI!
Reuters — Coinbase traffic surge after Super Bowl ad

events.title: FTX's sports and celebrity marketing unravels after collapse

research.significance: The reversal was a visual marker of how quickly crypto's sponsorship boom turned into reputational fallout.

sources.title: Miami-Dade — statement on FTX Arena
Miami-Dade — arena naming-rights termination record

events.title: Crypto donations become a major part of fundraising for Ukraine

research.summary: Ukraine's government said official crypto-donation channels had helped raise more than $53 million by 3 March following Russia's invasion.
research.significance: The fundraising demonstrated cryptocurrency's ability to mobilize global cross-border donations quickly during a national emergency.

sources.title: Ukraine Cabinet — $53M crypto raised by Mar. 3

events.title: Ethereum's move to proof-of-stake sharply reduces network energy use

research.summary: Ethereum estimates that The Merge reduced its energy consumption by about 99.95%.
research.significance: Energy impact is a major consequence of the canonical Merge, not a separate protocol event.

sources.title: Ethereum.org — The Merge

events.title: Luna Foundation Guard accumulates Bitcoin reserves

research.summary: Luna Foundation Guard entered the depeg with 80,394 BTC and other reserve assets; it said it converted or transferred most of those reserves in attempts to support UST, leaving 313 BTC by 16 May.
research.significance: The failed Bitcoin-reserve defense linked Terra's collapse directly to Bitcoin markets and became a major transparency and reserve-management story.

sources.title: The Block — LFG reserve disclosure, May 16 2022

events.title: Harmony Horizon bridge is exploited

research.summary: Harmony said attackers compromised its Horizon Ethereum Bridge in 11 transactions and removed tokens worth about $100 million at the time.
research.significance: The exploit added to 2022's cascade of bridge failures and highlighted the security risks of cross-chain custody and validator/key design.

sources.title: Harmony — Horizon Bridge hack updates

events.title: BNB Chain bridge exploit triggers emergency chain response

research.summary: An exploit in the BSC Token Hub allowed forged proofs and the withdrawal of 2 million BNB; validators coordinated to halt BNB Smart Chain and limit further losses.
research.significance: The emergency halt made the incident both a major bridge exploit and a high-profile case study in chain governance and validator coordination.

sources.title: BNB Chain — Ecosystem Update after BSC Token Hub exploit
BNB Chain — A Decentralized Response

events.title: Mango Markets is manipulated and drained

research.summary: Avraham Eisenberg manipulated the price of MNGO perpetual contracts and withdrew roughly $110 million in cryptocurrency from Mango Markets; a federal jury later convicted him on fraud and market-manipulation charges.
research.significance: The episode became DeFi's defining market-manipulation case and tested the line between protocol mechanics and conventional financial-market law.

sources.title: US DOJ — Mango Markets manipulation case

events.title: CoinDesk reports on Alameda balance sheet

research.summary: CoinDesk reported details from a private Alameda Research balance sheet showing $14.6 billion of assets at 30 June, with a large share tied to FTT and other tokens associated with Bankman-Fried-linked entities.
research.significance: The report crystallized concerns about the financial entanglement of FTX and Alameda and became the immediate informational trigger for the November crisis.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Alameda balance sheet report

events.title: CZ says Binance will liquidate its FTT holdings

research.summary: Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao announced that Binance intended to liquidate its remaining FTT holdings, citing 'recent revelations' and post-exit risk management.
research.significance: The tweet accelerated scrutiny and withdrawals and became one of the most consequential social-media posts in crypto history.

sources.title: CZ — FTT liquidation thread archived

events.title: Binance signs and then abandons a deal to acquire FTX

research.summary: On 8 November Binance signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire FTX.com amid its liquidity crisis; on 9 November Binance withdrew after due diligence and news reports about customer-fund handling and investigations.
research.significance: The one-day rescue attempt made the depth of FTX's liquidity and balance-sheet crisis unmistakable.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Binance/FTX non-binding acquisition agreement
Binance statement withdrawing from FTX acquisition, reproduced on Binance Square

events.title: US authorities seize Bitcoin linked to the 2016 Bitfinex hack

research.summary: US authorities announced the arrest of Ilya Lichtenstein and Heather Morgan and the seizure of more than $3.6 billion in Bitcoin linked to the 2016 Bitfinex hack.
research.significance: It was the Justice Department's largest financial seizure announced at the time and demonstrated how stolen Bitcoin could remain traceable years later.

sources.title: US DOJ — $3.6B crypto seizure linked to 2016 Bitfinex hack

research.significance: The contrast between an enormous crypto laundering case and Morgan's eccentric online persona made the episode unusually memorable outside finance.

sources.title: US DOJ — $3.6B crypto seizure linked to 2016 Bitfinex hack
